words.example: When the contract goes to legal, put a cover letter on the front.
words.exampleZh: 合同送法务时，请在最前面附上说明函。

words.example: List every attachment on the transmittal that goes with this packet.
words.exampleZh: 请在随这套材料附上的送文单里列出每一份附件。

words.example: Put a routing slip on the folder before it goes to the next office.
words.exampleZh: 文件夹送到下一个办公室之前，请放上一张传阅单。

words.example: Leave requests travel up the approval chain from supervisor to director.
words.exampleZh: 请假单沿着审批链，从主管报到主任。

words.example: Before payroll runs, finance has to counter-sign every overtime claim.
words.exampleZh: 发薪之前，每一份加班申报都要经财务会签。

words.meaning: 用户数据报协议（User Datagram Protocol）
words.example: UDP (User Datagram Protocol) 514 must reach the syslog server from every switch.
words.exampleZh: 每台交换机都要把 UDP（用户数据报协议）514 送到日志服务器。

words.example: TLS (Transport Layer Security) on the patient portal still allows an old version.
words.exampleZh: 患者门户的 TLS（传输层安全）还允许一个旧版本。

words.meaning: 加密网页协议（Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure）
words.example: HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) is required on the patient portal now.
words.exampleZh: 患者门户现在必须走 HTTPS（加密网页协议）。

words.example: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) on the old lab page redirects to the secure site.
words.exampleZh: 旧检验页面的 HTTP（网页协议）会跳到加密站点。

words.meaning: 文件传输协议（File Transfer Protocol）
words.example: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) to the instrument PC should close once the lab moves off it.
words.exampleZh: 等检验迁走，仪器电脑上的 FTP（文件传输协议）就该关掉。
